senses.gloss: to strike, clap, esp. to clap the hands against the hips to a certain tune in mourning or in rejoicing; cmp. טָפַח I.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 5:2">Bets. V, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 36b:16">36ᵇ</cite>) <he>ולא מְסַפְּקִין וכ׳</he> you must not clap or dance (on the Sabbath or Holy Day).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:2">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:2">VII</cite>), 2 <he>המְסַפֵּק וכ׳</he> he who strikes the hip, claps hands or dances by a flame (a superstitious practice); a. e.—V. <cite ref="O00789"><he>סִיפּוּק</he> I</cite>.

senses.gloss: (cmp. נָקַף, נָקַשׁ) to join closely; to attach; to engraft Y. Sabb. V, beg. 7ᵇ במְסַפֵּק חבל על חבל when he ties a rope to a rope (of the halter).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 6:9">Kil. VI, 9</cite> <he>סִפְּקָהּ בחבל וכ׳</he> if, in training the vine, he attached to it a rope or a reed (with which he fastened it to a plant).
<cite ref="Mishnah Parah 12:1">Par. XII, 1</cite> <he>האזוב … מְסַפְּקוֹ וכ׳</he> if the hyssop is too short, he ties it to a thread &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:3:7">Y. Orl. I, 61ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ילדה שסִיפְּקָהּ</he> a young plant (subject to ‘Orlah) which one engrafted on an old tree; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="O00789"><he>סִיפּוּק</he> I</cite>.
